name: Tona Toolkit – Developer Utilities
author: tonadesigns

sections.description:
Tona Toolkit is a collection of practical utilities designed to improve the WordPress development experience.

Built by the team at Tona Designs, this plugin focuses on real-world workflows used by developers building and maintaining modern WordPress websites.

Whether you’re managing client sites, optimizing performance, or cleaning up content, Tona Toolkit provides simple, effective tools without unnecessary bloat.

Features

Media Cleanup Scanner

Identify media files that are likely unused across your website.

  • Scans posts, post meta, and options for references
  • Detects featured images, attachment relationships, and URLs
  • Assigns confidence levels (High / Medium / Used)
  • Safely review and move unused files to trash

Note: This is a best-effort scan. Always review results before deleting files.

Plugin Downloader

Download any installed plugin directly from the Plugins screen as a ZIP file.

  • One-click download
  • Useful for backups or migrations
  • Works with both single-file and multi-file plugins

Page & Post Duplicator

Quickly duplicate any post or page as a draft.

  • Copies content, meta, and taxonomy data
  • Saves time when building similar layouts or pages

Redirect Manager

Create and manage 301 redirects.

  • Simple redirect interface
  • Normalize URLs automatically
  • Useful for SEO and site migrations

Site-Wide URL Update Tool

Replace URLs across your WordPress database.

  • Works with serialized data safely
  • Ideal for staging → production migrations
  • Supports dry-run mode

Media Tools

Automatically populate image metadata from filenames.

  • Fill alt text, titles, captions, and descriptions
  • Improves accessibility and SEO
  • Includes bulk update tool

Page Taxonomies

Enable categories and tags for pages.

  • Organize pages like posts
  • Include pages in archive queries

Custom Admin Dashboard

A streamlined dashboard experience for quick access to tools.

  • Quick actions
  • Internal tool navigation
  • Optional login redirect

Who is this for?

Tona Toolkit is built for:

  • WordPress developers
  • Freelancers managing multiple sites
  • Agencies building custom solutions
  • Site owners who want more control without heavy plugins

About Tona Designs

Tona Toolkit is developed by Tona Designs, a web design and software-focused agency.

We specialize in:

  • Custom WordPress development
  • Performance-focused websites
  • SEO and technical optimization
  • Lightweight, scalable software solutions

If you need custom functionality or tailored tools for your website, we can help.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/tona-toolkit directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Access the tools under the “Tona Toolkit” menu in the admin panel
sections.faq:
Is the Media Cleanup Scanner safe?

Yes, but it is a best-effort tool. Always review results before deleting media files.

Will this slow down my website?

No. Scans are limited in scope and designed to avoid heavy database usage.

Can I use only certain features?

Yes. Each feature works independently within the toolkit.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. Tona Toolkit is free to use.
